actions.canonical: She sits with her hips directly on the ground, both knees bent and both lower legs folded toward her left side, her feet near her left hip and the folded legs and sides of her feet resting on the ground. Her torso leans slightly backward, both palms planted just behind either side of her hips with fingers spread and elbows softly bent; her hips and folded legs support her lower body while both palms share the upper-body weight.

She sits with her hips on the ground, her right knee raised and her right foot flat on the ground in front of her. Her left knee opens low toward her left side, the left lower leg folds across the space in front of her with its foot near the inside of her right leg, and the outside of her left leg rests on the ground. Her torso leans slightly backward, her right hand resting on her right thigh just above the knee and her left palm planted behind her left hip; her hips, left leg, right foot and left palm support her body.

She sits with her hips on the ground, both legs bent in front of her, both knees close together and drawn toward her chest, and both feet flat on the ground. Her torso leans slightly forward from the hips toward her legs, both arms wrapping around her shins from either side with the forearms across the front of her shins and each hand holding the opposite forearm; her hips and feet bear her weight while her arms gather her legs inward.

She sits low on the ground in a relaxed but guarded street-candid posture, surrounded by several small cats resting or lingering close around her. Her legs are loosely arranged, her torso slightly tilted, and her arms rest naturally near her lap or around one leg. She looks upward toward the camera with an aloof, distant, slightly moody expression, as if quietly observing without inviting attention. The cats should feel naturally present and calm, adding a quiet intimate street mood rather than becoming the main subject.
